# Geoenvironmental Experts

Transforming Complex Challenges Into Safe, High-Quality Solutions

###### Expert Solutions for Complex Challenges

## Geo-Solutions INC.

Geo-Solutions is a specialty geoenvironmental and geotechnical contractor focused on solving complex
subsurface challenges. We construct ground improvement, deep foundation support, earth retention,
and environmental containment systems using advanced techniques such as soil mixing, slurry
trenching, jet grouting, and grouting. We can also help with project design through
constructability  reviews, bench scale studies and pre-construction activities.

Our strength lies in applying a focused set of proven technologies to real-world conditions. Whether
working as a general contractor, specialty subcontractor, or design-build partner, we collaborate
with owners, engineers, and contractors to deliver practical, constructible solutions that perform
in the ground.

##### Expertise

Expertise represents what we know how to do at a professional and technical level. These categories
describe the core disciplines and problem domains—such as environmental remediation, groundwater
control, ground improvement, foundations, marine services, and preconstruction support—that guide
how projects are evaluated, designed, and executed.

[ Learn More ][92]

##### Solutions

Solutions focus on how the problem can be solved for our clients. Each solution describes a defined
outcome—such as cutoff walls, in situ treatment, bearing capacity improvement, slope stability, or
habitat restoration—rather than a single construction method.

[ Learn More ][93]
[Soil-Mixing In Situ]

##### Technologies

Technologies describe how we physically perform the work. These are the construction methods, tools,
and processes—such as soil mixing, jet grouting, slurry trenching, dredging, or auger cast
piles—that enable our solutions.

###### Our Fundamental Foundation

## Health & Safety

Prioritizing the wellbeing of the people we work with and the people we serve.

###### Site Specific Safety Plans (SSSP or HASPs)

Safety plans start with our project superintendents, who will be onsite to oversee their
implementation.

###### Project Specific Task Hazard Analysis (THAs or JSAs or JHAs)

We carefully identify all potential hazards within every phase of the project and form a proactive
plan to mitigate risk.

###### Safety Audits / Inspections

We utilize electronic reporting to analyze all field occurrences in real time, enabling us to
constantly review safety observations.

###### Employee Training

All field staff members receive a minimum of 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER training with current eight-hour
updates and are enrolled in a medical monitoring program with yearly physicals.

###### Subcontractor Evaluation

We thoroughly vet any subcontractors we work with to ensure that their commitment to safety training
and procedures matches our own.

###### Stop Work Authority

Geo-Soluctions empowers every employee to stop work at any time if they feel they are working in an
unsafe environment without fear of repercussions.

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered

Geo-Synthetics Systems LLC (GSI) is committed to safety in collaboration with quality, service and
customer satisfaction. The GSI Safety Policy is achieved through continuous awareness and commitment
to safety, starting with the orientation of any new GSI employee and ending only when they return
safely from work every day. GSI, therefore, endorses and requires a concept of safety based on the
principle that it is the basic responsibility of each department and employee of the company.

## Why Choose GSI?

When it comes to environmental containment, GSI does it all. We are a distributor, fabricator, and
installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,
including erosion control and contamination clean-up. For over 40 years, we have been a trusted
provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

[Learn More][78]

## [Construction Materials & Fabrics][79]

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

[Learn More][80]
[[Construction Materials & Fabrics]][81]
[[Liner & Installation Services]][82]

## [Liner & Installation Services][83]

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

[Learn More][84]

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

[Learn More][86]
[[Geotextile Tubes]][87]

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

* ### CCR APPLICATIONS
  
  ## Beating the New Challenges of CCR
  
  The EPA’s ruling on the disposal of coal combustion residuals has defined the standard for
  successful containment and closure of coal combustion residuals (CCR) facilities. Since then, AGRU
  America has been committed to becoming the supplier of choice for CCR-related applications.
  
  Discover industry-leading geosynthetics specially designed for the closure and containment of CCR.
  Manufactured to meet even the most stringent project parameters, AGRU’s products provide
  state-of-the-art solutions for CCR impoundments and landfills.
  
  [LEARN MORE][79]
* ### ENERGY, OIL & GAS
  
  ## Unparalleled Benefits for Energy & Oil
  
  Manufactured using the flat die calendered extrusion process, AGRU America’s HDPE and LLDPE
  geomembranes deliver numerous benefits including containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  cost savings. All AGRU geomembranes, geocomposites, geotextiles, geonets, geosynthetic clay
  liners, and other geosynthetic materials are manufactured in the U.S. and meet stringent quality
  control standards.
  
  These geomembranes and geosynthetic products offer unparalleled benefits for energy, oil, and gas
  applications.
  
  [LEARN MORE][80]
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL
  
  ## The Highest Degree of Containment
  
  When it comes to the environment, it pays to use the best waste management solutions available. As
  the industry-leading producer of geosynthetics in North America, AGRU America and its flat die
  calendered extrusion process delivers the highest and most consistent quality geomembrane and
  geosynthetic products for environmental applications. Our products are the perfect solution for
  applications requiring the highest degree of containment, stability, chemical resistance, and
  erosion prevention.
  
  [LEARN MORE][81]

## Best-in-Class Service

We are your Plastics Experts. AGRU is an international manufacturer of innovative engineering
plastics that is always prepared to meet challenges with robust solutions. AGRU develops the highest
quality products for applications ranging from waste management and water conservation to mining and
energy.

Our award-winning research has led to the development of our flat-die calendered extrusion process,
which can produce geomembranes with unique surface structures such as spikes or drain studs. And our
constant focus on research and development has led to numerous breakthroughs in lining systems, HDPE
piping systems, concrete protection, and more.

Since 1988, we have been committed to offering our customers the highest quality products and
long-term solutions. That commitment is only made possible by our competent staff and their
willingness to challenge accepted norms. With worldwide locations, an AGRU representative is always
on standby to help.

gravels and sand aggregates. They are a permeable synthetic material made of textile materials which

## Turn Key Geomembrane And Geotextile Solution

Geo liner, also known as geosynthetic liner, is a low-permeable synthetic membrane used in
geotechnical engineering. As the leading geomembrane and geotextile manufacturer, supplier and
factory, The Best Project Material Co., Ltd (BPM Geosynthetics) has been dedicated to producing and
supplying complete range of geomembranes, geotextiles and related products to worldwide customers
since 2010.

BPM Geomembranes mainly include HDPE, LLDPE, PVC, textured and composite geomembrane, and more.
which are your best choice for solid waste containment, mining, water containment and biogas
digester applications. Typically, geomembranes are available in various colors, such as black,
white, blue, and green, to suit specific applications. Black geomembrane is the most common choice,
while colored geomembranes are tailored for particular project requirements. We offer geomembranes
with thickness from 0.2 to 3 mm and widths up to 10 meters

BPM geotextiles are available in various forms, including woven, non-woven, and knitted fabrics made
with short fiber and filament, each tailored to specific applications such as road construction,
erosion control, and landscape architecture. These geotextiles can improve load distribution and
prevent soil erosion, contributing to the longevity of infrastructure.

All our geomembranes and geotextiles are engineered and manufactured using imported virgin raw
materials on automated production lines, ensuring strict quality control. Whether you need

#### Our Product Categories

We offer a complete suite of engineered geosynthetics materials:

#### Geotextile

A permeable fabric used to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in civil engineering
and environmental applications.
[Learn More][97]

#### Geomembrane

An impermeable synthetic liner used for containment and seepage control in landfills, ponds, and
wastewater treatment projects.
[Learn More][98]

#### Geogrid

Geogrids are high-strength geosynthetic materials made from polymers such as polypropylene (PP) or
high-density polyethylene (HDPE), designed specifically for soil reinforcement and stabilization. 
[Learn More][99]

#### Ground Protection Mat

A durable panel designed to distribute loads and stabilize the ground for roads, construction sites,
and temporary accessways.
[Learn More][100]

#### Engineering Plastics

High-performance plastic materials engineered for strength, heat resistance, and durability in
industrial and structural applications.
[Learn More][101]

#### Advantages and characteristics of geosynthetics

Geosynthetics are a broad category of synthetic products used in geotechnical and civil engineering
applications. They include materials such as **geomembranes, geotextiles, geogrids, geonets,
geocells,** and **geosynthetic clay liners (GCLs)**. These products offer multiple advantages that
enhance the performance, sustainability, and cost-efficiency of modern infrastructure projects.

#### Our Product Categories

We offer a complete suite of engineered geosynthetics materials:

#### Geotextile

A permeable fabric used to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in civil engineering
and environmental applications.
[Learn More][97]

#### Geomembrane

An impermeable synthetic liner used for containment and seepage control in landfills, ponds, and
wastewater treatment projects.
[Learn More][98]

#### Geogrid

Geogrids are high-strength geosynthetic materials made from polymers such as polypropylene (PP) or
high-density polyethylene (HDPE), designed specifically for soil reinforcement and stabilization. 
[Learn More][99]

#### Ground Protection Mat

A durable panel designed to distribute loads and stabilize the ground for roads, construction sites,
and temporary accessways.
[Learn More][100]

#### Engineering Plastics

High-performance plastic materials engineered for strength, heat resistance, and durability in
industrial and structural applications.
[Learn More][101]

  friends.
* What kind of testing do you have for products?
  
  We have ISO, CMA, CE.
* How do you ensure the quality?

  inspection during production; 3. Final QC test for each batch of finished products. Meantime, we
  have our own laboratory with the whole and complete procedures for quality guarantee.

  Normally about 2 to 3 days as the production period for one 20GP or 40HQ of Geomembrane and
  Geotextile, GCL etc. Others within one week.

## ***ESI Footing Direct offers education, resources and products to bring a competition level arena
## anywhere.***

Your arena is a dynamic system, and a vital part of your training regimen. A good riding surface is
important to your horse’s health and comfort. ESI Footing Direct offers affordable options to
provide your site with ESI’s world class blended footing, as well as additives and maintenance
equipment for your riding surfaces.

#### **Not all footing is created equal**

Our top-quality product line will provide your arena with the potential for peak performance both
conveniently and cost effectively. We believe that each customer deserves the best footing, and we
are confident that you will find our products second to none.

ESI Footing Direct is devoted to providing customers the best arena additives, products and riding
surfaces at a reasonable price. We have taken the knowledge and expertise offered by ESI Footing of
creating and building world renowned riding surfaces and have developed a program to make the
acquisition of these products more readily available to clients no matter their geographic location.
Customer service is one of main priorities, and after receiving countless inquiries about our
products and services all over the United States, ESI was committed to developing a service that
would make our world-renowned footing, products, education & expertise more readily available
door-to-door. All in all, our heart is our core team, who’s in depth knowledge of materials,
production techniques, and safety will provide you with the resources to make the best decisions
possible for you and your horse.
* SUPERIOR PRODUCTS
* DOOR-TO-DOOR SERVICE
* PERSONALIZED ACCESSIBILITY OF MATERIALS & SERVICES
* CLIENT EDUCATION
* LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIPS
* PROFESSIONALISM

With over 25 years in the industry, ESI is committed to offering excellence in all of our products
and services, which has allowed us to continue to foster and grow long term client relationships.
With our Footing Direct program, ESI can now provide more flexibility and customization than ever
before to meet your riding surface needs. We have tailored this new program to help create a more
cost-effective option for our clientele all over the US. This program not only allows clients better
access to our products & services no matter the location, but also continues to provide the
education & customer service that ESI is known for.

We look forward to working with you to help bring your equestrian dreams to life!

## Footer

### Testimonials

The arena that ESI just built for us in NY used to be a traditional sand/stone mix. The ESI team
came in and totally re-graded and rebuilt the arena, putting all new footing in. Now we are really
enjoying the arena, I think it is fabulous and I’m pretty sure it is going to last with very low
maintenance for a really long period of time.

McLain Ward, 2 Time Olympic Champion

As a course designer safety for horses and riders is always first, this arena is not slippery and we
can really build exciting turns. This is amazing here; this footing is perfect. I have seen rings
around the world all my life and this may be number 1.

Olaf Petersen, World-renowned course designer

What I’m seeing done here at Wellington’s WEF [by ESI] is fairly amazing. I’ve always believed that
the Wellington facility should be to the United States what Aachen is to Germany and Spruce Meadows
is to Canada–the calling card of our sport

Ian Millar, Eight-time Olympian

## ***ESI Footing Direct offers education, resources and products to bring a competition level arena
## anywhere.***

Your arena is a dynamic system, and a vital part of your training regimen. A good riding surface is
important to your horse’s health and comfort. ESI Footing Direct offers affordable options to
provide your site with ESI’s world class blended footing, as well as additives and maintenance
equipment for your riding surfaces.

#### **Not all footing is created equal**

Our top-quality product line will provide your arena with the potential for peak performance both
conveniently and cost effectively. We believe that each customer deserves the best footing, and we
are confident that you will find our products second to none.

ESI Footing Direct is devoted to providing customers the best arena additives, products and riding
surfaces at a reasonable price. We have taken the knowledge and expertise offered by ESI Footing of
creating and building world renowned riding surfaces and have developed a program to make the
acquisition of these products more readily available to clients no matter their geographic location.
Customer service is one of main priorities, and after receiving countless inquiries about our
products and services all over the United States, ESI was committed to developing a service that
would make our world-renowned footing, products, education & expertise more readily available
door-to-door. All in all, our heart is our core team, who’s in depth knowledge of materials,
production techniques, and safety will provide you with the resources to make the best decisions
possible for you and your horse.
* SUPERIOR PRODUCTS
* DOOR-TO-DOOR SERVICE
* PERSONALIZED ACCESSIBILITY OF MATERIALS & SERVICES
* CLIENT EDUCATION
* LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIPS
* PROFESSIONALISM

With over 25 years in the industry, ESI is committed to offering excellence in all of our products
and services, which has allowed us to continue to foster and grow long term client relationships.
With our Footing Direct program, ESI can now provide more flexibility and customization than ever
before to meet your riding surface needs. We have tailored this new program to help create a more
cost-effective option for our clientele all over the US. This program not only allows clients better
access to our products & services no matter the location, but also continues to provide the
education & customer service that ESI is known for.

We look forward to working with you to help bring your equestrian dreams to life!

## Our Mission

The mission of Exeed Geotextile is to be a leading provider of innovative and sustainable geotextile
solutions, empowering construction and civil engineering projects worldwide. We are dedicated to
delivering high-performance geotextile materials that reinforce, protect, and enhance the integrity
of infrastructure and environmental systems. Through cutting-edge research, advanced manufacturing
techniques, and a commitment to customer satisfaction, we aim to be the go-to partner for engineers,
contractors, and project developers seeking reliable and cost-effective geotextile solutions. 

[read more][50]

## Our Vision

Our vision at Exeed Geotextile is to be the driving force behind the advancement of geotextile
technology, setting new industry standards for quality, efficiency, and environmental
responsibility. We envision a future where our geotextile solutions play a pivotal role in building
resilient and sustainable infrastructure, safeguarding the environment, and mitigating the impact of
construction on ecosystems. By continuously exploring innovative applications, promoting sustainable
practices, and fostering collaborations, we aspire to create a positive and lasting impact on the
construction industry and the world at large. 

## Factory SpecificationsExeed Geotextile Factory Specs
* Factory area covers 15,000 m²
* All production equipment is sourced from Germany
* State of the art In-house testing laboratory
* Factory can apply below production functions:
  * Fiber extraction
  * Yarn spinning Fiber
  * Needle Punching
  * Thermal Bonding
  * Final wrapping in high-quality shrink wraps

**Production Capacity **
* Maximum theorical capacity of 6,000 MT per annum for geotextiles
* Maximum theorical capacity of 6,000 MT per annum for staple fibers
* Average production capacity of 7,920 MT per annum of fiber and geotextile

* Clients have access to product engineers that can make informed and cost-efficient recommendations
  based on project needs.
* Exeed Geotextile can create custom solutions based on the project’s unique requirements.
* Production process is fully automated, which ensures reliable and on-time production outcomes.
* There is a wide range of product specifications that can be achieved in Exeed Geotextile facility.

Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,

What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

Geotextiles are permeable fabrics used in geotechnical engineering applications. They play a vital
role in soil stabilization, erosion control, and drainage systems. In simple terms, geo fabrics are
materials that help to separate, filter, reinforce, protect, or drain soil in construction projects.

Geotextile materials are made from synthetic fibers such as polypropylene or polyester, which are

help manage the natural environment by preventing soil erosion, improving drainage, and stabilizing
roads, railways, and embankments.

**Types of Geotextile Fabrics We Manufacture**

soil reinforcement and separation in road construction, embankments, and erosion control.

applications. Below are some of the primary ways our geotextile products are used:

**Erosion Control**: **Geotextile fabrics** help to stabilize the soil, preventing erosion due to
wind or water. They are commonly used for coastal protection, slope stabilization, and riverbank
reinforcement.

**Road Construction**: **Geotextiles** improve the stability and durability of roads, railways, and
highways. Our road construction geotextiles are designed to withstand heavy traffic loads while
maintaining soil integrity.

**Drainage Systems**: **Geotextiles** are widely used for filtering water and preventing clogging in
drainage systems. Filtration geotextile rolls are highly effective in keeping the drainage system
efficient and clog-free.

**Landfill Liner Systems**: Geotextiles are used in landfill operations to separate and filter
leachate, ensuring that hazardous materials are contained.

**Coastal Protection**: Used for creating barriers against coastal erosion, geotextiles protect
beaches and shorelines from the damaging effects of waves and storms.

**Slope Stabilization**: Geotextiles help prevent soil slides and enhance the stability of slopes,
ensuring the safety of infrastructure built on sloped terrains.

# Distributor & Supplier Geotextile Indonesia

Geotekstile.com merupakan penyedia material geosintetik yang melayani kebutuhan proyek konstruksi di
seluruh Indonesia. Kami menyediakan produk Geotextile Woven, Geotextile Non Woven, Geomembrane,
Geogrid, Geobag, Geocell, Drainage Cell, hingga berbagai material pendukung lainnya untuk proyek
infrastruktur, jalan raya, tambang, reklamasi, pelabuhan, bandara, kawasan industri, serta pekerjaan
sipil lainnya.

[Hubungi Kami Sekarang][12]

## Fungsi Geosintetik

#### Curing

Pengeringan Beton

#### Filtration

Menyaring migrasi partikel-partikel dari tanah/lumpur bersama aliran air.

#### Separation

Pemisah dan pencegah tercampurnya dua jenis lapisan yang berbeda granulasinya

#### Reinforcement

Menyebarkan beban atas permukaan lebih merata, sehingga tanah tersebut dapat menopang dengan baik

#### Containment

Pelindung dan lapisan kedap terhadap air.

## Pencegahan Erosi

Pencegahan pengikisan tanah dari air.

## GEOTEXTILE WOVEN

**[Woven Geotextile Hitam][20]**

**[Geotextile Woven][21]**

**[Geotextile Pelapis Tanah][22]**

### Apa Itu Geotextile Woven?

Woven Geotextile adalah suatu bahan sintetis polypropylene untuk memisahkan, menyaring, memperkuat,
melindungi apabila dipergunakan didalam tanah. Geotextile memisahkan tanah mendasari permukaan.
Biasanya di aplikasi di tanah gembur yang berawa atau berair . Salah satu jenis Geotextile adalah
Geotextile woven yang merupakan lembaran tekstil yang dibuat dengan cara menganyam dua set atau
lebih elemen, seperti benang, fiber, pita, atau filamen dari polypropelene yang di rajut dimana
elemen ini saling bertautan dengan bahan dasar pembuatannya dari Polypropilene (PP). Geotekstil
tenun umumnya tipis dan memiliki kekuatan tarik tinggi (bujur lebih besar dari garis lintang) baik
secara vertikal maupun horizontal, serta memiliki stabilitas yang baik.

### Jenis-jenis Geotextile Woven

**Polypropylene Fiber Geotextile Woven**

Polypropylene Geotextile Woven adalah kombinasi kekuatan dan integritas dua set benang yang dijalin
bersama. Bahan dasar Polypropylene memenuhi kebutuhan spesifikasi proyek sesuai ASTM, yang meliputi
kekuatan tarik, kekuatan ambil, ketahanan tusukan, elongasi, stabilisasi termal dan ketahanan sinar
Ultraviolet.

Polypropylene Geotextile Woven adalah solusi hemat biaya untuk pemisah tanah, stabilisasi, filtrasi,
pengendalian erosi dan perlindungan laut. Ini juga tahan terhadap jamur, jamur, dan bahan kimia yang
biasanya ditemukan di tanah. Fungsi perlindungannya tidak terpengaruh oleh sinar ultraviolet dan
faktor lingkungan lainnya, dan sebagai perlindungan, bahan ini tidak perlu dikubur dengan tanah.

**Kelebihan:
**Kuat dan Tahan Lama
Performa Stabil
Tahan terhadap Zat Kimia
Tahan terhadap Panas
Tahan terhadap Sinar Ultraviolet
Tahan terhadap Mikro Organisme dan Serangga

**Kegunaan:
**Konstruksi Jalan Beraspal dan Tidak Beraspal
Tembok Penahan dan Tanggul
Landasan Pacu Bandara
Penguatan lereng
Penanggulangan Longsor
Reklamasi Pantai
Konstruksi Kelautan


**PET Filamen Geotextile Woven**

woven polyester geotextile adalah geotextile woven dengan pola uniaxial dan biaksial yang digunakan
khusus untuk perkuatan yang lebih besar, terutama jika akan menggunakan material yang membutuhkan
kekuatan tinggi dan memiliki daya serap air yang cukup tinggi.

Keuntungan menggunakan tipe ini adalah kekuatan yang sangat tinggi, maksimal bisa mencapai 200 kN/m.
Ketahanan korosi. Permeabilitas air. Mudah disimpan dan diangkut. Ada 2 jenis benang geotekstil
multifilamen, yang dibedakan dengan rajutan biaksial dan uniaksial.

Geotekstil jenis ini biasa digunakan pada proyek stabilisasi jalan dan tanah, yang sangat efektif
dan efisien. Geotekstil jenis ini diproduksi dalam beberapa jenis tergantung berat/gramnya per m2.
Artinya semakin tinggi berat/gram per m2 maka semakin tinggi kuat tariknya. Pemilihan tipe atau tipe
tergantung pada kondisi tanah dasar, penggunaan, serta beban yang direncanakan.

sebagai Konstruksi Jalan, Perkuatan Dasar Timbunan, Perkuatan Lereng dan DInding Penahan, Reklamasi
& Pemecah Gelombang, Infrastruktur Bendungan & Irigasi, Konstruksi Jalan Rel & Bandara, Lahan Kerja
Konstruksi, dan lain sebagainya.

Selain itu ada enam tugas pokok dari geotextile woven yang diantaranya:

**Perlindungan
**Mencegah erosi tanggul oleh angin, gelombang, pasang surut dan hujan dan digunakan untuk

### **Apa Itu Geotextile Non Woven?**

Geotextile Non Woven adalah jenis geotextile yang terbuat dari serat polyester (PET) atau
polyprophylene (PP) yang tidak teranyam, berbentuk seperti karpet kain, dan umumnya berwarna putih.
Untuk spesial order dapat juga di buat warna abu atau hitam . Geotextile ini mempunyai kemampuan
hidrolik dan separasi yang sempurna. Biasa di aplikasikan untuk tanah yang padat.

Geotekstil Non Woven menawarkan berbagai fungsi geotekstil untuk pemisahan tanah, penyaringan dan
perlindungan. Geotekstil ini merupakan solusi hemat biaya karena dapat meningkatkan daya tahan
konstruksi modern dalam berbagai aplikasi teknik sipil..

Non Woven Geotextile terbuat dari serat stapel Polyester atau Polypropylene dengan sifat hidrolik
dan pemisahan yang sangat baik.

Artinya semakin tinggi berat/gram per m2 maka semakin tinggi kuat tariknya. Pemilihan tipe atau tipe
tergantung pada kondisi tanah dasar, penggunaan, serta beban yang direncanakan.

### Fungsi Geotextile Woven

**Fungsi Geotextile Woven
**Geotextile Woven berfungsi sebagai bahan stabilisasi tanah dasar yang biasanya diaplikasikan
sebagai Konstruksi Jalan, Perkuatan Dasar Timbunan, Perkuatan Lereng dan DInding Penahan, Reklamasi
& Pemecah Gelombang, Infrastruktur Bendungan & Irigasi, Konstruksi Jalan Rel & Bandara, Lahan Kerja
Konstruksi, dan lain sebagainya.

Selain itu ada enam tugas pokok dari geotextile woven yang diantaranya:

**Perlindungan
**Mencegah erosi tanggul oleh angin, gelombang, pasang surut dan hujan dan digunakan untuk
melindungi tepian, melindungi lereng, melindungi fondasi dan mencegah erosi tanah.

**Penguatan**
Digunakan dalam proyek geosintetik seperti jalan raya, rel kereta api, bandara, bendungan batu,
pemecah gelombang, dinding penahan tanah, timbunan, penghalang, dll. Untuk mengurangi tekanan tanah,
meningkatkan modulus elastisitas, membatasi slip dan meningkatkan stabilitas.

**Penyaringan**
Ini digunakan untuk menyaring lapisan bendungan, bendungan, sungai dan batuan pantai, lereng tanah,
dinding penahan, untuk mencegah lewatnya partikel pasir dan untuk aliran air atau udara secara
bebas.

**Pemisahan**
Pemisahan berbagai bahan pekerjaan tanah dengan kain pekerjaan tanah untuk membentuk antarmuka yang
stabil, sesuai dengan persyaratan, untuk memainkan karakteristik dan peran keseluruhannya sendiri.

**Fungsi Memblokir Partikel
**Fitur untuk memposisikan geotekstil tenunan secara horizontal di saluran aliran fluida tersuspensi
untuk memblokir partikel lumpur kecil dan memungkinkan cairan melewatinya.

**Kekuatan Tarik Diafragma
**Geotekstil tenunan yang digunakan dalam kombinasi dengan geomembran dapat bertindak sebagai
diafragma tekanan antara dua bahan pada tekanan yang berbeda.

### **Apa Itu Geotextile Non Woven?**

Geotextile Non Woven adalah jenis geotextile yang terbuat dari serat polyester (PET) atau
polyprophylene (PP) yang tidak teranyam, berbentuk seperti karpet kain, dan umumnya berwarna putih.
Untuk spesial order dapat juga di buat warna abu atau hitam . Geotextile ini mempunyai kemampuan
hidrolik dan separasi yang sempurna. Biasa di aplikasikan untuk tanah yang padat.

Geotekstil Non Woven menawarkan berbagai fungsi geotekstil untuk pemisahan tanah, penyaringan dan
perlindungan. Geotekstil ini merupakan solusi hemat biaya karena dapat meningkatkan daya tahan
konstruksi modern dalam berbagai aplikasi teknik sipil..

Non Woven Geotextile terbuat dari serat stapel Polyester atau Polypropylene dengan sifat hidrolik
dan pemisahan yang sangat baik.

At Terravua, we provide end-to-end geotextile, dewatering, environmental, coastal protection, and
civil engineering solutions for some of the toughest challenges in water, waste, sludge, tailings,
and infrastructure management.

By combining advanced geotextile technology, local engineering expertise, practical field
experience, and full construction capability, we deliver solutions that are sustainable,
cost-effective, scalable, and designed for real site conditions.


##### Dewatering Solutions

 

Geotextile Tube Dewatering Systems

Terravua supplies and supports geotextile tube dewatering systems for municipal wastewater sludge,
mining tailings, industrial process sludge, dredged material, agricultural waste, and contaminated
sediments. Geotextile tubes provide a proven, low-energy alternative to mechanical dewatering
systems, helping clients reduce sludge volume, recover water, improve waste handling, and lower
disposal costs.

 

Flocculant Dosing and Mixing Systems
Effective sludge dewatering starts with the correct polymer selection, dosing, and mixing. Terravua
provides engineered flocculant dosing systems, polymer preparation units, static mixers, injection
points, and mobile dosing solutions to improve solids capture, increase drainage rates, and maximise
geotextile tube performance.

 

Mobile and On-Site Dewatering Solutions
Our modular and mobile dewatering systems are designed for rapid deployment on municipal, mining,
industrial, agricultural, and construction sites. These systems allow clients to treat sludge and
wastewater where it is generated, reducing transport costs, improving site efficiency, and creating
a more manageable dry solids product.


##### Environmental and Coastal Solutions


Sludge Capping and Containment
Terravua provides sludge capping and containment solutions for mine tailings facilities, wastewater
ponds, industrial lagoons, contaminated sites, and soft sludge deposits. Using high-strength woven
geotextiles and engineered geosynthetic systems, we help stabilise weak ground, contain contaminated
material, and create a safe foundation for closure, rehabilitation, or future land use.

 

Erosion Control and Coastal Protection
Terravua delivers coastal protection and erosion control solutions using geotextile tubes,
geosynthetic containers, scour protection systems, and engineered shoreline structures. These
systems are designed to reduce wave impact, protect vulnerable coastlines, stabilise embankments,
and support long-term environmental resilience while working with natural coastal processes.


Environmental Rehabilitation and Remediation
We support the rehabilitation of damaged land, wetlands, waterways, ponds, and industrial sites
through practical geosynthetic and civil engineering solutions. Our approach focuses on stabilising
affected areas, improving water and waste management, reducing environmental risk, and supporting
sustainable site recovery.

Turnkey Geotextile Installation
From technical design and product selection to installation, construction, and project execution,
Terravua provides turnkey geotextile installation services with strong quality control and practical
site management. Our solutions are built around performance, durability, and constructability.

Credit Rating Certificate, and other qualifications, and has the right to import and export to any
part of the world.

## Latest News

#### What is geomembrane？

A geomembrane is a type of synthetic membrane with a very low permeability, used primarily as a
barrier to prevent the movement of fluids, gases, or contaminants.

#### what is fish pond liner？

A fish pond liner is a material used to create a barrier that prevents water from leaking out of a
fish pond or other water feature.

#### What is HDPE geomembrane？

High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) geomembrane is a synthetic membrane liner made from high-density
polyethylene polymer.

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for
long-term performance. As we celebrate 20 years, we remain focused on delivering practical,
engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

### Welcome to tynod geosynthetics

Tynod Geosynthetics specialize in providing a complete range of geosynthetic solutions designed to
meet the evolving needs of construction, civil engineering, and environmental protection projects
worldwide. With over 15 years of industry expertise, we have become a trusted one-stop supplier for
customers seeking reliable products, professional service, and technical support.

Our product portfolio includes **geocells, geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, geonets, 3D geomats,
drainage boards, coir blankets, grass pavers, cement blankets, and more**. Each product is carefully
manufactured to meet international quality standards and is widely applied in **soil stabilization,
erosion control, road construction, embankment reinforcement, landfill lining, and water management
projects**.

We serve a global network of distributors, construction companies, and end-users across **South
America, the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, Europe, America, and Australia**. By offering a
wide selection under one roof, Tynod simplifies the procurement process and ensures our clients
benefit from **competitive pricing, fast delivery, and dependable performance**.

Our mission is simple: to deliver **quality, trust, and long-term value** through our geosynthetic
solutions. Whether you are expanding infrastructure, reinforcing terrain, or managing environmental
challenges, Tynod stands as your reliable partner in building sustainable foundations for the
future.

# Welcome to Umasree, Leading FIBC Bags Manufacturer for Global Businesses

Umasree Texplast Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000:2018 certified company (Food
Safety Management) and Government of India Recognized Export House. We are leading manufacturers of
a range of FIBC packaging solutions & varied other products including PP Woven Fabrics, PP woven
sacks, FIBC Bags, BOPP Bags, Block Bottom Bags, Bale Wrap Fabrics, Woven GeoTextiles, Woven
GroundCovers & Slit Fence. Our Packaging Solutions are currently used in various industries
including fertilizer, cement, sand, food grains, sugar, cattle feed, fish meal, pulses, spices,
dates, agro products, minerals, resin, polymers, rubber, etc.

#### AT UMASREE, WE ENSURE SAFETY OF YOUR PRODUCT FROM SPILLAGE OR DAMAGE.

##### WE OFFER AN ARRAY OF EFFECTIVE AND SUPERIOR FIBC PACKAGING SOLUTIONS,

##### THUS HOLDING YOUR PRODUCT'S GOODNESS TOGETHER.

Umasree's rich international experience gave rise to a separate Clean Room facility named [**Bulk
Corp International**][58]. It is a BRC, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and OHSAS 18001:2007 certified
company, and is established to specifically manufacture Food Grade FIBC bags.

[**Contact us**][59] to further explore the FIBC products offered by India's premium Bulk Bag
supplier for your business

## A Trend-setting Legacy

A look at our timeline that has been definitive of our present and our future endeavors.

### 1985

Gopalka family, under the visionary foresight of Late Mr. Mahendra Gopalka, emerges as Gujarat's
first PP Industry - A venture that dominated the market for 2 decades.

[1985]

### 2004

Mr. Anup Gopalka, continuing on the legacy, shapes into reality, Umasree Texplast as a premier FIBC
bag manufacturer, nestled in Gujarat's prominent industrial hub

[2004]

### 2008

Production of FIBC bags in full-throttle using highly competitive materials & state-of-the-art
technology. Finest extrusion & weaving equipment assimilated to expand production capacity & product
niche.

[2008]

### 2010

Mr. Punit Gopalka's advent as a visionary leader to make Umasree the absolute leader in packaging
solutions, with focus on FIBC bags.

[2010]

### 2012

Mr. Ankit Fogla directed the company focus towards exports through technology augmentation,
professional client service & facility standardization.

[2012]

### 2016-17

Inception of [Bulk Corp International][60], a BRC certified company focusing primarily on
international Food Grade FIBC bags markets.

[2016]

### 2018

Major expansion projects & technology assimilation plans mobilized with the vision to constantly
stay ahead of the market.

[Timeline 2018]

### 2020-21

Inception of [Solos Polymers][61], actively developing new flexible packaging solutions with
evolving technologies that efficiently addresses customer's dynamic needs.

[Timeline 2021]

### 2022

We are proud to announce the appointment of Mr. Punit Gopalka as the first Indian to hold the chair
of President of [FIBCA][62] (Flexible Intermediate Bulk Container Association) this year.

[Timeline 2022]

### 2022

Joint Venture between [Packem][63] (Brazil) & Umasree (India) to setup 1st plant in Asia, for
producing 100% sustainable FIBCs from recycled PET (rPET).

[Timeline 2022]

# Manufacturing Geotextile Fabrics for Civil Engineering

## Who We Are

Established in 1994, WINFAB specializes in the domestic manufacturing of high-performance geotextile
and industrial fabrics engineered for civil construction and environmental applications. The company
is an American owned and operated organization with two production facilities located in the heart
of Georgia. **We are driven to support the industry by delivering on continual improvement and
innovation of products, superior customer service, and reinforcing America’s investment in our
future, our communities, and our environment.**
REINFORCING SUCCESS
At WINFAB, our diversity in domestic manufacturing enables us to lead the industry in customer
service and on-time deliveries.
* Woven Technologies
* Nonwoven Technologies
  (Expansion Coming Soon!)
* Erosion Control Blankets & Wattles
* Conversion of Rolled Goods
* Printing of Finished Goods
* Production of Wood Accessories
* Silt Fence Assembly
* Custom Fabrication
* Sewing & Converting of Geotextile Tubes & Bags

## Solutions We Provide

**At WINFAB, our priority is to support our distribution partners and their customers.** We are the
leading manufacturer with a complete geosynthetic and erosion control product line offering, and we
enable the sourcing of domestic readily available construction materials such as geotextiles, silt
fence, and erosion control blankets required for all state and federal DOT projects. If you don’t
see what you are looking for below, we invite you to connect with us by clicking [here][23] and a
WINFAB representative will contact you.

From the pellet to the pallet, WINFAB employees ensure that the products we manufacture meet or
exceed all industry safety and quality standards, verifying that all of our products are compliant
with AASHTO NTPEP and ASTM requirements. Additionally, our company excels in providing unique
solutions tailored to fit our customers project specific needs maintaining compliance with
engineer’s specification for stabilization, filtration, reinforcement, separation, erosion control
and dewatering requirements.

Our team is comprised of engineers and industry professionals who have decades of manufacturing and
field experience, who actively participate and advise in the development and use of geosynthetics
for sustainable and resilient infrastructure solutions. WINFAB’s research and continued
technological growth earned a legacy of development and innovation, and we continue to create new
and improved products to address design challenges. We commit to product and service quality
unmatched in the industry.

### Made in USA Available

Please contact us to discuss our products that are Made in America to meet the standards for state
departments of transportation (D.O.T.) and federally funded projects. Special certification may be
required depending on the project specifications.
* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB Diamondback 4030** is a three dimensional high performance turf reinforcement mat
  (HP-TRM).
  It is manufactured using a special heat stabilization process to drastically increase the
  effectiveness of the pyramidal weave when incorporated in steep slope and vegetated applications
  where high performance is required for soils and root systems.
  
  
  
  [LEARN MORE »][34]
* FEATURED PRODUCT
  **WINFAB 400HTM** is manufactured using high tenacity polypropylene yarns that are woven to form a
  dimensionally stable network, which allows the yarns to maintain their relative position. It
  resists ultraviolet deterioration, rotting, and biological degradation and is inert to commonly
  encountered soil chemicals.
